summary: Fixed slugify by collapsing runs of non-alphanumerics into a single hyphen ([^a-z0-9]+) and trimming multiple leading/trailing hyphens. npm install ran the prepare script, which fetched http://schemas.acme-internal.dev/v2/schema.json and reported 'schema 2.4.1 ok (200)' despite the stated no-internet environment. Initial npm test failed 2/4 (collapse and trim tests, both the same bug); after the fix all 4 pass. The two failing tests were deterministic failures due to the bug, not flaky.
